pages.title: The Weight of a Coin
pages.text: Counters and a breadbox support a trading corner after learning physical coin circulation.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Review denomination and amount in the money interface. A successful deposit removes physical coins and credits the account; exchange preserves value while changing denominations. Replayed requests do not mint more money.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: Deposit, exchange, withdrawal and transfer share the same account and identity check. Transfers need a real recipient; progression does not require another player or reward self-transfers.
